senses.gloss:
अध्वन् अध्वन्, आ, m. (said to be from अद्,
‘to eat,’ द् being changed to ध्, or fr. rt. अत्), a
road, way, orbit; a journey, course; distance; time;
means, method, resource; the zodiac (?), sky, air;
a place; a recension of the Vedas and the school up-
holding it; assault (?). अध्वन् becomes अध्व, अस्,
at the end of some compounds.
—अध्व-ग, अस्, आ,
अम्, travelling; (अस्), m. a traveller; a camel, a mule;
the sun; (आ), f. Gangā (the river).
—अध्व-गत्, त्,
m. a traveller.
—अध्व-गत्य्-अन्त or अध्व-गन्त-
व्य, अस्, m. measure of length applicable to roads.
—अध्वग-भोग्य, अस्, m. (traveller's delight), N.
of a tree (Spondias Mangifera).
—अध्व-गमन,
अम्, n. act of travelling.
—अध्व-गामिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, wayfaring.
—अध्व-गा, f. a plant, also called
Svarṇulī.
—अध्व-पति, इस्, m. (lord of the orbits or
of the zodiac), the sun.
—अध्व-रथ, अस्, m. a
travelling car.
—अध्व-शल्य, अस्, m. a plant, Achy-
ranthes Aspera.
—अध्वाधिप (˚व-अध्˚) or अध्वेश
(˚व-ईश्˚), अस्, m. officer in charge of the police on
the public roads.

अध्वनीन or अध्वन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, speeding on
a journey; (अस्), a traveller.
अध्वयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. running, quick.

अध्वर अ-ध्वर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अ, not, and
ध्वर, crookedness, injury), Ved. not crooked,
unbroken, uninterrupted; durable; sound; intent;
(अस्), m. a religious or liturgical service, a sacrifice,
especially the Soma sacrifice; N. of a Vasu; of the chief
of a family; (अम्), n. sky or air.
—अध्वर-कर्मन्,
अ, n. performance of the Adhvara or connected with
it.
—अध्वर-कल्पा, f., N. of an optional sacrifice
(Kāmyeṣṭi).
—अध्वर-काण्ड, अम्, n. title of the
book in the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa which refers to
Adhvaras.
—अध्वर-कृत्, त्, m. performing an
Adhvara.
—अध्वर-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, intended for
an Adhvara.
—अध्वर-दीक्षणीया, f. consecration
connected with the Adhvara.
—अध्वर-प्रायश्चित्ति,
इस्, f. expiation connected with the Adhvara.
—अध्व-
र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing the word Adhvara.
[]
—अध्वर-श्री, ईस्, m., Ved. glory (i. e. patron) of the
Adhvara.
—अध्वर-समिष्ट-यजुस्, उस्, n., N. of
an aggregate of nine libations connected with the
Adhvara.
—अध्वर-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, or अध्वरे-
ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. standing at (or engaged in)
an Adhvara.

अध्वरीय or अध्वर्य, nom. (fr. अध्वर), P.
अध्वरीयति or अध्वर्यति, P. to be desirous of
having an Adhvara performed; to institute one (?).

अध्वर्यु, उस्, m. one who institutes an Adhvara;
any officiating priest; technical name of a priest of a
particular class (as distinguished from the होतृ, the
उद्गातृ, and the Brahman classes). The Adhvarya-
vas “had to measure the ground, to build the altar,
to prepare the sacrificial vessels, to fetch wood and
water, to light the fire, to bring the animal and
immolate it.” Whilst engaged in these duties, they
had to repeat, without interruption or mistake, the
hymns of the Yajur-veda; hence that Veda itself is also
called Adhvaryu or Adhvaryavas, and the latter word
also means adherents of the Yajur-veda.
—अध्वर्यु-
काण्ड, अम्, n. title of a book of mantras or prayers
intended for Adhvaryavas.
—अध्वर्यु-क्रतु, उस्,
m. sacrificial act performed by the Adhvaryu.
—अध्वर्यु-वेद, अस्, m. the Yajur-veda.

अध्वर्यु; add — (उस्), f. the wife of an Adhvaryu
priest, (Pāṇ. IV. 1, 66.)

अध्वस्मन् अ-ध्वस्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. im-
perishable (?); not causing to fall (?); unveiled, open
to the light (?).

अध्वान्त अ-ध्वान्त, अम्, n. (not positive
darkness), twilight, gloom, shade.
—अध्वान्त-शा-
त्रव, अस्, m. a plant, Cassia Fistula or Bignonia
Indica (not an enemy to darkness, i. e. blossoming in
the shade).

आध्वनिक आध्वनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अध्वन्),
being on a journey.

आध्वरिक आध्वरिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अ-ध्वर),
belonging to a Soma sacrifice.

आध्वर्यव आध्वर्यव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अध्-
वर्यु), belonging to the Adhvaryu or to the Yajur-
veda; (अम्), n. service at a sacrifice, especially the
office of an Adhvaryu priest.
